using Xunit;
using Moq;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using System;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Tests;

public class ClusterConfigTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_NoCollision_ReturnsThis()
    {
        // Arrange
        var config = new ClusterConfig();
        var senderConfig = new ClusterConfig();
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger<ClusterConfig>>().Object;

        // Set up different epochs to avoid collision
        config = config.InitializeLocalWorker("local1", "127.0.0.1", 7000, 1, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "localhost");
        senderConfig = senderConfig.InitializeLocalWorker("sender1", "127.0.0.2", 7001, 2, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "senderhost");

        // Act
        var result = config.HandleConfigEpochCollision(senderConfig, logger);

        // Assert
        Assert.Same(config, result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_SenderNodeIdSmaller_ReturnsThis()
    {
        // Arrange
        var config = new ClusterConfig();
        var senderConfig = new ClusterConfig();
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger<ClusterConfig>>().Object;

        // Set up same epoch but sender node ID smaller
        config = config.InitializeLocalWorker("local2", "127.0.0.1", 7000, 1, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "localhost");
        senderConfig = senderConfig.InitializeLocalWorker("local1", "127.0.0.2", 7001, 1, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "senderhost");

        // Act
        var result = config.HandleConfigEpochCollision(senderConfig, logger);

        // Assert
        Assert.Same(config, result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_EpochCollision_LogsWarningAndBumpsEpoch()
    {
        // Arrange
        var config = new ClusterConfig();
        var senderConfig = new ClusterConfig();
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<ClusterConfig>>();
        mockLogger.Setup(x => x.IsEnabled(It.IsAny<LogLevel>())).Returns(true);
        var logger = mockLogger.Object;

        // Set up collision scenario: same epoch, sender node ID larger
        config = config.InitializeLocalWorker("local1", "127.0.0.1", 7000, 1, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "localhost");
        senderConfig = senderConfig.InitializeLocalWorker("local2", "127.0.0.2", 7001, 1, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "senderhost");

        // Act
        var result = config.HandleConfigEpochCollision(senderConfig, logger);

        // Assert
        mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.LogWarning(
                It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("Epoch Collision 1 <> 1")),
                It.Is<long>(epoch => epoch == 1),
                It.Is<long>(epoch => epoch == 1),
                It.Is<string>(ip => ip == "127.0.0.1"),
                It.Is<int>(port => port == 7000),
                It.Is<string>(id => id == "local1"),
                It.Is<string>(ip => ip == "127.0.0.2"),
                It.Is<int>(port => port == 7001),
                It.Is<string>(id => id == "local2")),
            Times.Once);

        // Verify epoch was bumped
        Assert.Equal(2, result.LocalNodeConfigEpoch);
        Assert.NotSame(config, result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_NullLogger_NoException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var config = new ClusterConfig();
        var senderConfig = new ClusterConfig();

        config = config.InitializeLocalWorker("local1", "127.0.0.1", 7000, 1, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "localhost");
        senderConfig = senderConfig.InitializeLocalWorker("local2", "127.0.0.2", 7001, 1, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "senderhost");

        // Act
        var result = config.HandleConfigEpochCollision(senderConfig, null);

        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(2, result.LocalNodeConfigEpoch);
    }
}

using Xunit;
using Moq;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;
using System.Linq;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Tests
{
    public class ClusterConfigHandleConfigEpochCollisionTests
    {
        private static readonly string DefaultLocalNodeId = "local1";
        private static readonly string DefaultLocalIp = "127.0.0.1";
        private static readonly int DefaultLocalPort = 7000;
        private static readonly string DefaultSenderNodeId = "sender2";
        private static readonly string DefaultSenderIp = "127.0.0.2";
        private static readonly int DefaultSenderPort = 7001;
        private static readonly long DefaultEpoch = 1;

        [Fact]
        public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_DifferentEpochs_ReturnsThis()
        {
            // Arrange
            var config = CreateInitializedConfig(DefaultLocalNodeId, DefaultLocalIp, DefaultLocalPort, DefaultEpoch);
            var senderConfig = CreateInitializedConfig(DefaultSenderNodeId, DefaultSenderIp, DefaultSenderPort, DefaultEpoch + 1);
            var logger = new Mock<ILogger<ClusterConfig>>().Object;

            // Act
            var result = config.HandleConfigEpochCollision(senderConfig, logger);

            // Assert
            Assert.Same(config, result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_SameEpochSenderNodeIdSmaller_ReturnsThis()
        {
            // Arrange
            var config = CreateInitializedConfig("local2", DefaultLocalIp, DefaultLocalPort, DefaultEpoch);
            var senderConfig = CreateInitializedConfig("local1", DefaultSenderIp, DefaultSenderPort, DefaultEpoch);
            var logger = new Mock<ILogger<ClusterConfig>>().Object;

            // Act
            var result = config.HandleConfigEpochCollision(senderConfig, logger);

            // Assert
            Assert.Same(config, result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_SameEpochSenderNodeIdLarger_LogsWarningAndBumpsEpoch()
        {
            // Arrange
            var config = CreateInitializedConfig(DefaultLocalNodeId, DefaultLocalIp, DefaultLocalPort, DefaultEpoch);
            var senderConfig = CreateInitializedConfig(DefaultSenderNodeId, DefaultSenderIp, DefaultSenderPort, DefaultEpoch);
            
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<ClusterConfig>>();
            mockLogger.Setup(x => x.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Warning)).Returns(true);
            var logger = mockLogger.Object;

            // Act
            var result = config.HandleConfigEpochCollision(senderConfig, logger);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.LogWarning(
                    "Epoch Collision {localNodeConfigEpoch} <> {senderConfigEpoch} [{LocalNodeIp}:{LocalNodePort},{localNodeId}] [{senderIp}:{senderPort},{senderNodeId}]",
                    DefaultEpoch,
                    DefaultEpoch,
                    DefaultLocalIp,
                    DefaultLocalPort,
                    DefaultLocalNodeId,
                    DefaultSenderIp,
                    DefaultSenderPort,
                    DefaultSenderNodeId),
                Times.Once);

            Assert.NotSame(config, result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_NullLogger_DoesNotThrow()
        {
            // Arrange
            var config = CreateInitializedConfig(DefaultLocalNodeId, DefaultLocalIp, DefaultLocalPort, DefaultEpoch);
            var senderConfig = CreateInitializedConfig(DefaultSenderNodeId, DefaultSenderIp, DefaultSenderPort, DefaultEpoch);

            // Act & Assert
            var result = config.HandleConfigEpochCollision(senderConfig, null);
            Assert.NotNull(result);
        }

        private static ClusterConfig CreateInitializedConfig(
            string nodeId, 
            string ip, 
            int port, 
            long epoch)
        {
            var config = new ClusterConfig();
            return config.InitializeLocalWorker(nodeId, ip, port, epoch, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "localhost");
        }
    }
}
